findings.text: the comment claims a grant naming the shared crew runs root is refused, but declared_grant_refusal at reckon/_worker_fence.py:1554 refuses only a filesystem root, a git checkout and a registered project root; no ancestor or peer-run overlap is checked, so a dispatch declaring the shared crew runs root composes a writable grant over every peer run directory, which the plan's deliverable says a grant must never cover.

removing the workspace-write tier's grant of the main checkout is a behaviour change with no added test; tests/test_fence_never_binds_the_main_checkout.py composes only the worktree-full tier, so re-adding roots.add(Path(repository)) for workspace-write would pass every test in the suite.

the fence_argv docstring narrates the replaced implementation and dates the incident, and tests/test_a_worker_can_write_only_what_it_was_granted.py:3 repeats it; the repository's comment-hygiene rule keeps changelog and provenance prose out of source because the mechanism sentence stands alone.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_worker_can_write_only_what_it_was_granted.py:209 and :224 redden if the root returns to --dev-bind, and :397 reddens if an assertion treats an empty .git marker as a checkout; the removal of the workspace-write repository grant has no such test.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_worker_can_write_only_what_it_was_granted.py exercises every done-when case and the reviewed manifest records 66 passed at d8e4d746f0 against 58 passed at bee04f7fb9 plus a negative-control arm of 8 failed, EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: the new helpers follow the module's existing style, but reckon/_worker_fence.py:2259 and tests/test_a_worker_can_write_only_what_it_was_granted.py:3 narrate the replaced implementation and date the incident, which the repository's comment-hygiene rule keeps out of source.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_worker_fence.py:2320 mounts --ro-bind / / and binds only handed roots writable, and reckon/_backends.py:327 refuses a declared grant naming a filesystem root or project root, which is the deliverable; only the plan's peer-run-overlap clause has no code behind it.
justifications.reuse: reckon/_worker_fence.py:1514 extends the incident policy but its own _is_git_checkout at :1487 adds a third inline git rev-parse --show-toplevel wrapper beside reckon/pages.py:358 and reckon/hooks/worker_stop.py:170 instead of a shared helper; project_root_paths does reuse mounted_project_docs and protected_paths.
justifications.scope_discipline: every one of the 13 paths in bee04f7fb9..bc734dea05 is inside the manifest's declared write paths, and no path outside them appears in the diff.
